Lagrange gives |C_G(x)|=p^m with m<n, whence class size p^{n-m}, divisible by p. Summing conjugacy-class sizes yields |G|=|Z(G)| plus multiples of p. Since p divides |G|, p divides |Z(G)|. As 1_G is central and p>=2, the center has at least p elements and therefore a nonidentity element.
